policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O faces RICO-style suit tied to data-center expansion
items.summary: A lawsuit alleges a coordinated scheme to secure approval for O’s large Georgia AI data-center project, including racketeering-type claims. Material downside risk is reputational and potentially regulatory/cost timing.

items.headline: O secures further funding at $1.25T value
items.summary: O completed an $11B portion of a larger private funding at a reported $1.25T valuation, with marquee backers participating. Reinforces IPO-capital runway and ongoing investor appetite for late-stage AI scale.

items.headline: V announces $251M Series D to scale W-Series returns
items.summary: V announced a $251M Series D to expand its microgravity-enabled life-sciences processing and space-to-Earth return capability, citing a total ~$598M capital raised to date. Strengthens capacity and commercial traction prospects.

items.headline: G IPO SEC form-d style capital raise posted
items.summary: A Form D for G was filed/posted for a June 2026 sale of securities. While not a new round in this window, it’s a primary-source indicator of ongoing fundraising cadence for the inference-cloud buildout.
